chart_review.chart_window: 126 causal sessions before signal through 126 context sessions after signal, capped at 2021-06-30

compressed_chart_interpretation.not_a_shape_rule: Long horizontal duration alone did not distinguish winners; many failed signals also formed long bases.
compressed_chart_interpretation.mechanism: The useful visual question is whether a forced seller-transfer anchor was followed by genuine supply digestion before a first demand reclaim, rather than a one-bar spike into still-active inventory.
compressed_chart_interpretation.market_state: Bull and bear labels alone did not separate outcomes. Weak states therefore require stronger stock-level digestion plus causal improvement in both market return and participation; no future market label is used.

derived_causal_features.anchor_pre60_position: Anchor coordinate close within the min-low/max-high range of valid tradable same-lineage bars from anchor-60 through anchor, known when the anchor completed. Fewer than ten valid observations fails R1 closed; the window is never shortened.
derived_causal_features.absorption_share: Frozen below-anchor-VWAP session count divided by anchor_age_sessions minus one.
derived_causal_features.prior10_range: Max coordinate high divided by min coordinate low minus one over the last ten valid tradable bars strictly before the signal.
derived_causal_features.late_to_early_turnover: Median turnover of the last five valid tradable pre-signal bars divided by median turnover of the first five valid tradable post-anchor bars.
derived_causal_features.late_low_progression: Median coordinate low of the last five valid tradable pre-signal bars divided by that of the preceding five bars minus one.
derived_causal_features.market_acceleration: Signal-close market_median_ret20 minus ret60 and positive-ret20 share minus positive-ret60 share.

rules.meaning: The seller anchor did not occur in the top fifth of its already-observable prior-60 price range.
At least one market month separated anchor and reclaim, with a majority of the intervening sessions below anchor VWAP.
The ten tradable bars before reclaim occupied a broad but bounded base rather than a highly unstable path.
Late pre-reclaim turnover did not exceed early post-anchor turnover and the recent five-bar low distribution did not break more than two percent below the preceding five-bar distribution.
Bull states need two of the three digestion confirmations; transition states additionally need one improving market scale; bear states need all three confirmations and improving return plus breadth.
rules.condition: R1 and ((BULL and digestion_score >= 2) or (TRANSITION and digestion_score >= 2 and (return_acceleration > 0 or breadth_acceleration > 0)) or (BEAR and digestion_score == 3 and return_acceleration > 0 and breadth_acceleration > 0))

frozen_admission: R1_FORCED_TRANSFER_NOT_MATURE_DISTRIBUTION and R5_CAUSAL_MARKET_ROUTE, where digestion_score is the count of R2, R3, and R4.

threshold_rationale.0.80: Exclude the upper price-range quintile as mature distribution risk; no neighboring percentile was tested.
threshold_rationale.0.50: A simple majority of the absorption interval below frozen anchor VWAP.
threshold_rationale.0.15: A deliberately broad ten-bar base boundary, not an optimized tight-range cutoff.
threshold_rationale.1.00: No increase in median turnover from early transfer to late base.
threshold_rationale.-0.02: Recent low distribution remains economically stable within two percent.
threshold_rationale.market_signs: Only sign of already-observed horizon acceleration is used.

evaluation.translation: Unchanged frozen A67 target, first legal buyable open signal+1 through signal+3, T+1 target eligibility, H20 time stop, and 40 bp round-trip cost.
evaluation.strict_pass_gate: For every signal year: completed events > 50, mean net return > 4%, and median net return > 0.
evaluation.later_period_policy: Read no 2022-2024 feature or outcome unless every annual development gate passes; close exact formulation without threshold rescue otherwise.
